name: Benchmark 032 — Optimal fixed readiness + ITIL control

stages.name: Prepare Solution / Change Readiness v0.2
stages.instruction: Consume the supplied normalized BA baseline directly. Do not redo requirements analysis, decomposition, acceptance-criteria design or test-case design. Produce the solution/design and Change Enablement readiness handoff defined by the Skill, preserving all evidence/status/authority distinctions. Only after the complete readiness artifact is produced, append the exact final line `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: CHANGE_READINESS`.

stages.name: Assess ITIL Alignment v0.2
stages.instruction: Consume only the supplied change-readiness handoff. Before substantive work, require the exact upstream marker `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: CHANGE_READINESS`. If it is absent, return only `UPSTREAM_INCOMPLETE: CHANGE_READINESS` and stop. If present, assess relevant ITIL 4 practice alignment without inventing local policy, formal compliance, approval authority or missing evidence. Preserve upstream readiness/status distinctions. Only after the complete ITIL alignment artifact is produced, append the exact final line `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: ITIL_ALIGNMENT`.
